task: Round 10 regression and claim-verification hunt over commits 915e2e4 and 32ba566, at HEAD 32ba566. Two jobs, both adversarial. FIRST, independently re-derive the coordinator's central verification claim rather than trusting it. The commits assert that 7 of 7 SSOT guards and 5 of 5 canary guards die when reverted, i.e. every new guard has a fixture that fails if the guard is removed. Do that yourself: for each guard, disable it in a scratch copy, run the suite, and record which fixture died and whether the fixture that died is actually ON TOPIC for that guard or merely collaterally broken. The binder rewrite deleted the previous algorithm entirely and changed the shape of find_assertions' return value from 3-tuples to 4-tuples; check every consumer of it, including _matching_exemption and the board path, for an unpacking or semantics mismatch of the kind that already bit once here. The frozen-role guard was narrowed from all non-current roles to 'frozen' only after it fired on a legitimate historical assertion; verify that narrowing did not reopen the smuggle it was built to close. The test_hooks.py fixture was changed to copy sibling checkers into its temp tree; verify that did not weaken any existing fixture or make any test pass for a new and wrong reason. Finally, check the RECORD against the code: the ledger and frozen rows for D-070 Parts B9 and B10 make specific numeric and behavioural claims, and three of the last five defects in this chain were in the record rather than the code. Report every disagreement, and report the attacks that found nothing too, with exact inputs.
